claims.claim: CLAUDE.md files exceeding 40 KB cause Claude to display degradation warnings and context mismanagement
claims.citation: Officialny limit: 40 KB / ~40,000 znakow - po przekroczeniu ClaudeCode wyswietla ostrzezenie o degradacji
claims.source_location: AP-01: Bloated CLAUDE.md, paragraph 4

claims.claim: Only 7.4% of typical CLAUDE.md content (4,847+ lines, 10,847 tokens) proves relevant per session
claims.citation: Typowy przegladany plik: 4,847+ linii, zuzywa 10,847 tokenow. Tylko 7.4% tej zawartosci okazuje sie relewantna per sesja
claims.source_location: AP-01: Bloated CLAUDE.md, Real-world numbers section

claims.claim: A 10,000-token CLAUDE.md wastes approximately 5,000 tokens per turn due to duplication and obsolete rules
claims.citation: 10,000-tokenowy CLAUDE.md = 5,000 tokenow zmarnowanych per kazda kolejka (duplikaty, stare zasady)
claims.source_location: AP-01: Bloated CLAUDE.md, Real-world numbers section

claims.claim: Claude's quality degrades at 20-40% context fill, not 80-90% as conventionally assumed
claims.citation: Claude's quality starts slipping at 20-40% of context capacity. Not at 100%. Not at 80%.
claims.source_location: AP-06: Context Rot, CRITICAL FINDING section

claims.claim: Peak performance occurs at 0-20% context fill; significant degradation begins above 40% fill
claims.citation: 0-20% fill: peak performance. 20-40% fill: quality begins slipping (40k-80k tokens dla 200k okna). 40%+ fill: significant degradation
claims.source_location: AP-06: Context Rot, Thresholds section

claims.claim: Circular skill imports create infinite recursion or loader crashes with messages like 'Circular dependency detected'
claims.citation: Loader wykrywa cykl (zbior 'currently loading') i rzuca komunikat: 'Circular dependency detected while loading skill: pdf -> tdd -> pdf'
claims.source_location: AP-02: Recursive Circular @imports, Objaw section

claims.claim: MCP tools can generate 191,300 tokens of overhead before the first user prompt in a 167-tool setup
claims.citation: 167 narzedzi MCP = 191,300 tokenow overheadu przed pierwszym promptem
claims.source_location: Exec Summary, Key numbers section

claims.claim: MCP Docker with 135 tools generated 144,802 tokens of tool definition overhead alone (GitHub Issue #12241)
claims.citation: MCP_DOCKER = 135 narzedzi, 125,964 tokenow; chrome-devtools = 26 narzedzi, 17,512 tokenow. Lacznie 144,802 tokenow
claims.source_location: AP-03: MCP Response Size Bomb, Udokumentowane przypadki section

claims.claim: Read tool without offset/limit parameters on large files causes content to remain permanently in context for all subsequent turns
claims.citation: A 10,000-line log file stays in context for every subsequent message in that session. Reduntantne wczytanie tego samego pliku: worst case = 33 wczytania jednego pliku = 561K tokenow zmarnowanych
claims.source_location: AP-04: Read Bez head_limit, Kosztowy wzorzec section

claims.claim: Reading an 8.5 MB file via Read tool permanently corrupted the session and all subsequent sessions in the project (Issue #6780)
claims.citation: Uzytkownik wczytal plik obrazu 8.5 MB. Sesja zostala zatruta i uploadowana do chmury Anthropic. WSZYSTKIE nowe sesje w tym projekcie dziedziczyly zatrute dane.
claims.source_location: CS-03: Read Tool Session Corruption

claims.claim: Resume and continue flags cause 652,069 phantom output tokens to be generated without user input (GitHub Issue #41930)
claims.citation: 652,069 output tokenow wygenerowanych bez promptow uzytkownika podczas session resume. Pojedynczy 'morning' = 15% limitu Max 5x
claims.source_location: AP-08: Invisible Token Inflation, Resume/Continue flag bug section

claims.claim: MCP Docker / chrome-devtools response sizes and schema overhead create 72,000 tokens of overhead before first user prompt in 50-tool setup
claims.citation: 50-tool setup = 72,000 tokenow schema overhead na starcie sesji (PRZED jakimkolwiek userem promptem)
claims.source_location: AP-03: MCP Response Size Bomb, Tool schema overhead section

claims.claim: Tool Search feature in settings reduces MCP overhead by 46.9% (from 51K to 8.5K tokens)
claims.citation: Tool Search feature: redukcja 46.9% (51K -> 8.5K tokenow) wedlug raportow uzytkownikow
claims.source_location: AP-03: MCP Response Size Bomb, Remedium section

claims.claim: Sessions running uncontrolled Bash commands (rg, find, cat, npm install) without limits produce 30,000+ character outputs that waste tokens
claims.citation: Agent lub uzytkownik uruchamia komendy Bash ktore produkuja ogromny output: rg pattern . bez --max-count, find / bez -maxdepth, cat large_file, npm install (verbose), docker logs container (full history). Output przekracza 30,000 znakow
claims.source_location: AP-05: Niekontrolowany Bash Output, Objaw section

claims.claim: A 4.5-minute manual Claude Chat task took 18 minutes in a degraded 50-turn Claude Code session with 134,800 tokens and only 25,000 relevant
claims.citation: Task ktory zajmuje 4.5 minuty przez manual Claude Chat: 18 minut w zdegradowanej dlugiej sesji Claude Code. Sesja turn 50: 134,800 tokenow, tylko 25,000 relewantnych (18.5%) - 81.5% to 'dead weight'
claims.source_location: AP-06: Context Rot, Real-world benchmark section

claims.claim: Autocompact can enter infinite loops when tool output exceeds context window size (Issues #2283, #34363, #9579, #42647)
claims.citation: Claude Code wchodzi w petle kompakcji: kompaktuje -> kontekst natychmiast przepelnia sie ponownie -> kompaktuje znow. Udokumentowane przypadki: Issue #2283, #34363, #9579, #42647
claims.source_location: AP-07: Autocompact Thrashing, Udokumentowane przypadki section

claims.claim: Claude Code v2.1.100 injects invisible 20,000 tokens per request compared to v2.1.98 (40% consumption increase)
claims.citation: Invisible 20,000 tokenow per request od wersji v2.1.100. Analiza HTTP proxy: v2.1.98 = 49,726 tokenow; v2.1.100 = 69,922 tokenow. Delta: ~40% faster consumption
claims.source_location: AP-08: Invisible Token Inflation, Bug v2.1.100 section

claims.claim: Kitchen Sink Sessions mixing unrelated tasks cause attention diffusion and context pollution across tasks
claims.citation: Uzytkownik zaczyna od jednego zadania ('dodaj feature X'), pozniej pyta o cos niespokrewnionego ('jak sie robi Y?'), wraca do feature X, pozniej pyta o debugowanie ('czemu Z sie psuje?'). Sesja akumuluje niepowiazany kontekst ktory zmienia sie w szum dla modelu.
claims.source_location: AP-09: Kitchen Sink Session, Objaw section

claims.claim: Cache prompt expiry occurs after ~5 minutes of idle time, forcing full context rebuild with 10x cost multiplier on resume
claims.citation: Cache promptow wygasa po ~5 minutach bezczynnosci. Po powrocie uzytkownika: pelny rebuild kontekstu zamiast taniego cache-read. Mnoznik kosztu: 10x (cache miss vs cache hit)
claims.source_location: AP-10: Cache Expiry z Idle Gap, Objaw section

claims.claim: In 858 analyzed sessions, 54% of turns occurred after idle gaps longer than 5 minutes, wasting ~12.3 million tokens total
claims.citation: 54% kolejek nastepowalo po idle gap dluzszym niz 5 minut. Mnoznik kosztu: 10x (cache miss vs cache hit). ~12.3 milionow zmarnowanych tokenow w jednym zbiorze sesji
claims.source_location: AP-10: Cache Expiry, Udokumentowane liczby section

claims.claim: Anthropic's custom Bun fork performs string replacement on all API requests, breaking cache when billing-related strings appear in conversation
claims.citation: Anthropic custom Bun fork robi string replacement na wszystkich requestach API. Gdy historia konwersacji zawiera billing-related slowa: replacement trafia w zle miejsce. Psuje cache prefix = pelny rebuild = 10-20x inflacja kosztow
claims.source_location: AP-08: Invisible Token Inflation, Billing sentinel string bug section

claims.claim: Circular dependencies in skill files create transitive bloat through import chains (A->B->C->D) beyond simple cycles
claims.citation: Nawet bez cyklu, lancuchy importow A -> B -> C -> D -> ... laduja ogromne ilosci kontekstu ktore uzytkownik nie zamierzal zaladowac. Kazdy wezzel lancucha to dodatkowe tokeny.
claims.source_location: AP-02: Recursive Circular @imports, Subtypowy problem: transitive bloat section

claims.claim: A developer's $1,600 billing incident resulted from architecture costs: bloated CLAUDE.md (93% wasted), extended thinking without limits, and March 2026 caching bugs
claims.citation: Deweloper opisuje bill $1,600 od Claude Code API. Przyczyny: (1) pelne wczytywanie repo bez .claudeignore (93% tokenow na nierelewantny kod), (2) extended thinking bez ustawionego MAX_THINKING_TOKENS, (3) caching bugs marca 2026 z 10-20x inflacja
claims.source_location: CS-05: $1,600 Billing Incident

claims.claim: Conflicts exist between sources on when context degradation begins: 20-40% (bswen.com) vs 70-75% (MindStudio) vs practical threshold 147-152K tokens
claims.citation: Zrodlo A (docs.bswen.com): degradacja przy 20-40% kontekstu. Zrodlo B (MindStudio): degradacja przy 70-75% kontekstu. Zrodlo C: praktyczna granica = 147,000-152,000 tokenow
claims.source_location: Controversies i Konflikty, KONFLIKT 1 section

claims.claim: Autocompact is effective as a safety net only when tool outputs are small; with large outputs it enters thrashing loops
claims.citation: Autocompact jest bezpieczny gdy tool outputs sa male. Przy duzych outputach (MCP, log files) - staje sie petla. Blad lezacy po obu stronach: zly tool output rozmiar + brak configurowalnego thresholds.
claims.source_location: Controversies i Konflikty, KONFLIKT 2 section

claims.claim: The resume/continue flags are unsafe as of March 2026 due to cache invalidation bugs; safer alternative is /clear + fresh session with memory injection
claims.citation: Oficjalna dokumentacja: polecany dla kontynuacji pracy. GitHub Issue #41930: glowna przyczyna 652K phantom tokens w marcu 2026. Ocena (April 2026): Tymczasowo unsafe
claims.source_location: Controversies i Konflikty, KONFLIKT 3 section

claims.claim: Community-aggregated Reddit data shows 'Claude Code is usable for ~45 minutes daily' before quota exhaustion in Kitchen Sink sessions
claims.citation: Claude Code is the best coding tool I've ever used, for the 45 minutes a day I can actually use it.
claims.source_location: AP-09: Kitchen Sink Session, Cytaty Reddit section

claims.claim: Most agent token waste comes from uncontrolled discovery (directory listing, speculative file opens, vague grepping) rather than intentional processing
claims.citation: Most agent token waste comes from uncontrolled discovery. Claude lists directories, opens files speculatively, greps vaguely, then repeats.
claims.source_location: AP-05: Niekontrolowany Bash Output, Cytaty spolecznosci section

claims.claim: 93-99% of starting tokens can be wasted loading irrelevant code without .claudeignore configuration
claims.citation: 93-99% tokenow startowych moze byc zmarnowanych na nierelewantny kod bez .claudeignore
claims.source_location: Exec Summary, Key numbers section

claims.claim: Official Anthropic best-practices docs list Kitchen Sink Sessions as the #1 common error, with /clear being the recommended remedium
claims.citation: Oficjalny Anthropic naming (best-practices docs): 'The Kitchen Sink Session' - punkt 1 na liscie typowych bledow. Remedium: /clear miedzy niezwiazanymi zadaniami.
claims.source_location: AP-09: Kitchen Sink Session, Oficjalny Anthropic naming section

gaps_flagged: Brak konkretnych linkow do Reddit postow - zrodla agregowane przez morphllm.com, aitooldiscovery.com bez bezposrednich URL
Brak danych empirycznych na temat nadmiernej specjalizacji w skill files (tysiace linii) - tylko anegdotalne wzmianka
Context pollution ze zwracajacych sie parallel subagentow - brak szczegolowych metryk, tylko ogolne zalecenie 2-4 subagents
Invisible token inflation z v2.1.100 - brak potwierdzenia czy zostala naprawiona w pozniejszych wersjach po marcu 2026
Brak danych na temat interakcji miedzy autocompact a MCP tool schemas - czy autocompact zmniejsza schemat czy tylko kontekst
conflicts_flagged: R6.C4 vs R6.C24: Degradation threshold - bswen.com mowi 20-40%, MindStudio 70-75%, inni 147-152K tokens. Probable roznica w typach zadan.
R6.C13 vs AP-03: Tool Search feature (46.9% reduction) a MCP Docker bomb (144K tokens) - Tool Search wplywa na schemat czy response size?
R6.C26 (unsafe resume flag) kontra oficjalne Anthropic docs - status czy jest to znane i naprawione w wersjach po marcu 2026?
